commits.summary: Recheck Spring findings on published releases (verification pending)
commits.body:

Record the 5.1.4 to 5.1.5 JDBC binary break and prepare the upstream reproductions. The P29 maintainer follow-up adds Javadoc and gives the same instructions and six matching JVM histories.

All six selected suites passed and the older Spring release check still agrees. The independent 188-history replay and 24 original-method debugger trials passed. Job 20261126-132138-replay-published-spring-versions-and-the repeats the 62 published histories and the cron follow-up offline and compares the three output files byte for byte.

commits.body:

Job 20261126-132656-check-bean-overrides-on-direct-and-inher repeats the new hierarchy comparison.
